name: trend_counter_trend_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, when the 2-minute Supertrend flips bullish (bearish) while price is above (below) session VWAP and the 5-minute EMA trend aligns, it signals that institutional directional algorithms have committed to a short-term trend — their TWAP/VWAP execution orders are now directionally biased and will sustain the move for the next 30-90 seconds. The counter-trend sell signal fires when 3-minute RSI diverges from price (new spot high but RSI lower) AND NIFTY has overshot VWAP by 15+ spot points — at that level, VWAP-benchmarked algorithms begin systematic fade-selling against the benchmark, providing an asymmetric early exit before trend exhaustion. This asymmetry captures the institutional directional burst while avoiding the mean-reversion tail that kills symmetric trend exits.

indicators.name: supertrend_24_3
indicators.purpose: 24-bar (2-minute) ATR period. NOT the naive 12x scale from the original's 10 bars (which would give 120 bars = 10-min — far too slow for 30-120s holds). 2-min ATR detects micro-trend flips that precede 30-90 second institutional directional runs on NIFTY. Shorter lookback makes the Supertrend reactive enough to serve as a trade trigger rather than a context filter.

indicators.name: rsi_36
indicators.purpose: 3-minute RSI (36 bars at 5s). Original used 14-bar RSI on 1-min charts (14-min window) to detect divergences in a 20-90 min hold. At 5s with 30-120s holds, divergence must develop within the holding window — so we use 3-min RSI. A 14-bar RSI at 5s (70 seconds) would be too noisy; 36 bars provides a stable but fast-enough divergence signal that forms before the trend reverses.

indicators.name: ema_60
indicators.purpose: 5-minute EMA (60 bars) as trend context filter. Original used 20-bar 1-min EMA (20-min context) for the same purpose. We use 60 bars (5 min) — compressed because NIFTY's intraday trend regime shifts faster than individual equities; a 20-min EMA context filter on NIFTY at 5s would keep us in stale regime reads for too long during reversals.

indicators.name: vwap_session
indicators.formula: Cumulative VWAP reset at 09:15 each session
indicators.purpose: Cumulative measure — no lookback scaling needed. Aligns entry direction with institutional benchmark (price above VWAP = demand side, below = supply side). Distance from VWAP in spot points serves as the overshoot exit threshold: when NIFTY has drifted 15+ pts from VWAP, VWAP-benchmarked algos activate counter-pressure.

conditions: Supertrend(24, 3.0) flips bullish this bar (direction changes -1 → +1)
buy_ce.confirmation: No active bearish RSI divergence on this bar (close not making 90s relative high while RSI declining)

conditions: Supertrend(24, 3.0) flips bearish this bar (direction changes +1 → -1)
buy_pe.confirmation: No active bullish RSI divergence on this bar

exit.stop_rationale: 5 option pts ≈ 10 NIFTY spot pts (delta ~0.5). A genuine Supertrend flip on NIFTY should not see a 10-pt adverse move within 30s if institutional flow is real — if it does, the flip was noise. Calibrated to sit between 30s typical moves (2-5 pts) and 1-min typical moves (3-7 pts) from conventions table; wide enough to survive normal oscillation, tight enough to cap damage on false flips.
exit.target_rationale: 8 option pts ≈ 16 NIFTY spot pts. A confirmed Supertrend flip accompanied by VWAP alignment and 5-min EMA context typically drives NIFTY 15-25 spot pts over 60-120 seconds. Targeting 8 pts captures the lower end of the 2-min move range (5-10 pts in conventions table) at 1:1.6 R:R — realistic given the early counter-trend exit may close positions before full target.

filters.vix_filter: None — Supertrend auto-adapts to volatility via ATR; no external VIX overlay needed
filters.time_filter: 09:20-15:25 IST; avoids pre-open noise (first 5 min) and EOD illiquidity
filters.volume_filter: None — NIFTY index volume is noisy at 5s; Supertrend + VWAP alignment provide quality filter
filters.trend_filter: close > EMA(60) for long entries, close < EMA(60) for short entries (5-min context)
filters.spread_filter: Not applicable — limit order execution at candle close prices

edge.edge_decay_risk: Moderate — Supertrend is widely known but the asymmetric counter-trend exit overlay (RSI divergence + VWAP overshoot) is less commonly implemented at 5s frequency; as HFT normalizes these patterns, edge may compress within 12-18 months

adaptation_notes: Original applied to NIFTY50/NiftyNext50 equity stocks on 1-min bars, hold 20-90 min. Key adaptations: (1) Supertrend ATR period: 10 bars (10-min) → 24 bars (2-min) — catching fast micro-trend flips, not slow equity trends. NOT 12x blind scale (which would be 120-bar = 10-min, identical to original). (2) RSI: 14 bars (14-min) → 36 bars (3-min) — divergence must form within the 30-120s hold window. (3) EMA context: 20 bars (20-min) → 60 bars (5-min) — NIFTY regime changes faster than single equities. (4) VWAP distance threshold: 60 bps (original) → 15 spot points (~6 bps at NIFTY 24000) — original 60 bps threshold calibrated for slow equity moves over 20-90 min; at 5s on an index, we use absolute point distance because the overshoot that triggers VWAP-algo counter-pressure is magnitude-based, not percentage-based. (5) ATR-based stops → fixed option premium points (5 stop, 8 target) consistent with 5s options pipeline cost model.
weaknesses: Supertrend flips on 2-min ATR at 5s can whipsaw during NIFTY opening auction (09:15-09:25) and pre-expiry settlement sessions; session start filter at 09:20 partially mitigates but does not eliminate

RSI divergence detection over 18 bars (90 seconds) compares only two distant points — may trigger on normal RSI oscillation rather than structural divergence; a proper swing-high divergence detector would require more complex logic
Supertrend flip frequency on NIFTY at 2-min ATR is low (1-4 per day typical), limiting statistical significance on 12-day test window
